choices.text: Because the battery has thrown the energy away
Because the energy changed form and moved somewhere else, like light and heat leaving a bulb
Because energy only works while a switch is on

questions.feedback: That trap answer is the one to unlearn: Energy is used up, like fuel disappearing from a tank. Reteach point: Energy is never used up: it changes form and moves somewhere else. Check scene s4: follow the energy dot from the stored circle to the heat circle - it travels, it does not disappear.
questions.misconception: Energy is used up, like fuel disappearing from a tank.
questions.prompt: Why is energy NOT used up when a torch stops shining?

questions.answer: Electrical energy changes into light and heat.
questions.feedback: Scene s3 fixes the chain: energy travels from the battery along the wire as electrical energy, then leaves the bulb as light and heat.
questions.prompt: State the energy change that happens at the bulb of a torch.

questions.feedback: Scene s2 fixes the picture: the radio changes electrical energy into sound, and the sound lines spread outward from the radio.
questions.prompt: Which form of energy does a radio give out when it is playing?

questions.answer: It changes form and moves somewhere else, for example stored energy becoming heat.
questions.feedback: Scene s4 fixes the idea: the energy dot travels from the stored circle to the heat circle - energy is transferred, never used up.
questions.prompt: In one sentence, say what really happens to energy when a toy car slows down and stops.
